purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Revert To Prepared details.
features: Revert To Prepared Function allows the user to change the status of Port Release to Prepared.
PR status should be "Supplied" or "Full Return".
If the Container is linked to a B/L, this option is not allowed.

events.description: Opens the Revert to Prepared (PR Number) popup asking "Do you want to Revert the PR?" with a remark box
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Revert to Prepared from the single function menu

events.description: Reverts the PR and the Status changes to Prepared. Message: "Port release prepared successfully"
events.triggered_when: User enters a valid remark and clicks Ok

events.description: Closes the popup without changing the PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks Cancel on the popup

search.name: Remark
search.ui: Mandatory. The user types a valid remark for reverting the PR to Prepared
